items.name: Basic Health Check
items.whoFor: Adults who want a general look at blood, sugar, cholesterol, liver, kidney and urine tests in one visit.
items.preparation: 10–12 hours fasting; plain water is allowed. Bring a first-morning urine sample if you can.

items.name: Diabetes Care
items.whoFor: People who live with diabetes or are keeping an eye on their blood sugar, and want the usual tests together.
items.preparation: 10–12 hours fasting; plain water is allowed. Ask your doctor before changing any medicine on the day.

items.name: Heart Check
items.whoFor: Adults who want heart-related blood tests along with sugar, kidney and blood count tests.
items.preparation: 10–12 hours fasting; plain water is allowed

items.name: Women's Health
items.whoFor: Women who want a general check covering blood count, thyroid, vitamins and hormones.
items.preparation: No fasting needed. A morning sample is preferred; ask the lab about timing for the hormone test.

items.name: Senior Citizen
items.whoFor: Older adults who want a wide set of routine tests together, so fewer visits are needed.
items.preparation: 10–12 hours fasting; plain water is allowed. Home collection can be arranged for those who find travelling hard.
